title: Kelowna Bachelorette Half Day Wine Tour Guided With 4 Wineries
blurb:
Hey Ladies! Welcome to the most fun Kelowna Bachelorette Half Day Wine Tour in the Okanagan! Looking for that final “let your hair down and party” wine tour experience with your gal pals? We’ve got you covered with our all inclusive Kelowna Bachelorette Half Day Wine Tour designed just for you!

We’ve taken care of all the details like complimentary bubbly to toast the bride and a curated selection of wineries to ensure a wine filled good time on this special day! All Kelowna Bachelorette Half Day Wine Tour packages also include a Bluetooth Karaoke mic for you to rock out with in the van!

Enjoy VIP treatment, front of the line access to award winning wineries in either Kelowna, Lake Country or West Kelowna and ride in style in our customized brand new luxury vans.

This is the #1 best selling Kelowna Bachelorette Half Day Wine Tour, and for good reason! Young, energetic guides, incredible playlists, endless photos taken of your group, and amazing winery experiences throughout the day.
